name: be_po_urchin
cite: Po-Be modulated neutron initiator ('Urchin'), layer C-100 (research doc Trinity technical reference): ~2 cm Be sphere with 50 Ci (~11 mg) Po-210 in 15 grooves, Au+Ni plating separating Po from Be. Atom fractions from 6.989 g Be-9 + 0.011 g Po-210 (~7 g total). Be metal density 1.85 g/cm3 (public); the ~7 g figure is a hollow shell + inner pellet, so a solid-density mass estimate overshoots (README).
